fields.statement: QA at 1d8815c86 with a binary built from the branch: in a scratch Rhiza root and git repo, a workflow with [env] GOTMPDIR = "{run_tmp}" and one command step, run via rhiza run start --foreground. The run succeeded; the step saw GOTMPDIR=~/.cache/rhiza/run-tmp/<run id>, the folder existed during the step, git rev-parse from it said 'not a git repository', and after the run the folder was gone while a sibling run-tmp folder (R1) and the shared parent stayed. Nothing was made under the repo's .git/rhiza/runs beyond the run journal.

QA at 1d8815c86: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/ci-install$ with GOTMPDIR set to a scratch repo's .git/rhiza/tmp failed before the script ran ('inside a git dir: set GOTMPDIR outside the repository'); with GOTMPDIR set to a folder in that repo's work tree it failed naming the work tree; neither run wrote .github/workflows/rhiza.yml or anything else into the repo (git status clean). With GOTMPDIR outside any repo ci-install passed, and TestCheckWorkOutsideRepo passes.
